evidence_binding.journal_link: the gate/check row's detail (' — ' + the statement JSON) carries artifact {path, sha256, bytes}; the journal is hash-chained; gate/check has a closed payload schema (a new key is a journal format bump), so the reference lives in the detail text; the artifact holds story_id, attempt, index, revision (the candidate the probe ran at), session (the finder's stream)

summary_contract.bound: valid JSON, <= SUMMARY_MAX (1500) characters of the whole text, by construction: decisive fields 60/40/20/160/24/20/160 (+120 artifact_why) measured on the encoding; the four elastic fields share what is left less 26 characters per marker, smallest first; checked by a seeded sweep of 400 adversarial findings and the worst encodings (longest 1,493 in the sweep)
summary_contract.marker: elided: {field: number of characters of that field's text left out}; present only when something was cut and authoritative; a value that does not fit is the prefix of its canonical JSON text, a string

route['token'] (OCR's token, redacted from its stream the same way)

failure_to_preserve.behaviour: a finding that would block (blocks() said so) and whose artifact cannot be preserved refuses the review: CapabilityUnrunnable (CAPABILITY_UNRUNNABLE, owner ENVIRONMENT, 'every finding discarded', the finding id and the reason in the provider/result row); a finding that would not block is journaled with artifact:null and artifact_why
failure_to_preserve.why: fail closed: 'reported but non-blocking' would turn every confirmed, anchored defect into a pass whenever the evidence store fails (a fail-open on an environment fault); the module's own answers to 'the review's evidence cannot be established' are the same (_unchanged: every finding discarded; OCR coverage INDETERMINATE under fix-loop). A cut fragment never blocks.

--verify treats a blocking review row with no `artifact` key (a run of an earlier release) as a NOTE, so no earlier run's verdict changes; the stricter reading (a problem: 'a cut fragment is not grounds to block') would REFUTE every earlier run that blocked on a review finding. Confirm the note.

MANIFEST_FORMAT was not bumped (precedent: RUN.started.json joined the list without a bump); an older verifier refuses a newer run by naming the files it does not know. Confirm, or ask for aisef-v2-evidence/2 when the group is non-empty.
A story whose finding cannot be preserved fails with CAPABILITY_UNRUNNABLE (owner ENVIRONMENT, retried through the ENVIRONMENT limit) rather than a new failure code: a new code is a taxonomy change.
